description: Commits that must be present before publishing the BuildKart staging web bundle or APK. Add an entry whenever a change must survive future feature-branch deploys. Checked by tooling/check_staging_release_line.py.

required.label: U-007 product tile v2
required.why: B2C product card layout (price + off% + stacked MRP, 44x44 wishlist/add).

required.label: U-007 tile tightening
required.why: Keeps 65% of the card for the image at 1.0 text scale.

required.label: U-009 B2B site pincode
required.why: Business checkout prices delivery from the selected site pincode, not a hardcoded 302001.

required.label: U-009 pincode delivery fee
required.why: Tax-inclusive flat fee, minor-unit pricing and priced store shipping options.

required.label: U-007 translucent tile controls
required.why: Wishlist/add controls keep the product photo visible; B2B stays solid.

required.label: QC 1-8 money/address/confirmation/CTA fixes
required.why: Reconciling money formatting, order address, confirmation number, sticky CTA, auto fee, semantics.

required.label: Android release build config
required.why: Kotlin incremental caches disabled so the signed APK builds reproducibly on Windows.
